title: Legal Framework (Concepts)
notes: Educational concepts only. Real statutes and rules vary by jurisdiction.
Use this for vocabulary, not legal advice.

concepts.title: Actus Reus
concepts.definition: The physical act component of an offense (conceptual).
common_questions: What is the causal link to harm?

concepts.title: Mens Rea
concepts.definition: The mental state element (intent/knowledge/recklessness/negligence) depending on offense.
common_questions: What did the person know or intend?

concepts.title: Causation (Conceptual)
concepts.definition: Link between conduct and result (actual + proximate concepts).
common_questions: Would the harm have occurred but for the act?

concepts.title: Beyond a Reasonable Doubt (Criminal Standard)
concepts.definition: High burden of proof used in criminal trials (conceptual).
concepts.practice_note: Investigations should document both supporting and conflicting facts.

concepts.title: Probable Cause (Conceptual)
concepts.definition: Threshold concept for certain actions; varies by context and jurisdiction.
concepts.practice_note: Keep narratives factual and avoid speculation.

concepts.title: Exclusionary Rule (Conceptual)
concepts.definition: Evidence may be suppressed if obtained in violation of certain legal protections.
concepts.practice_note: Preservation and documentation reduce preventable suppression risks.

concepts.title: Chain of Custody
concepts.definition: Documented evidence handling history from collection to presentation.
concepts.practice_note: Missing links weaken admissibility and credibility.
